> Maybe it's just because bundlesize itself was updated. Because I see no other lib that could be responsible for this in the updates.

I'm reading the same size from our own compile script. Digging into the dependencies I have updated: so far keeping the old lodash would have been worse.
Ok let's move on. Maybe we could try to think about some wins that we could implement to reduce the size later.
